log-entry.title: Open questions at the Phase 4 gate (packet )

body.p: For the owner. Every gate box is ticked ().

item.p: 0.2.0, XQuery and XSLT. 0.2.0 is still untagged; CHANGELOG.md lists XQuery and XSLT under "Unreleased". Tag 0.2.0 at the Phase 2 commit, or fold both into one release.

WebAssembly budgets (Proposed, three items): the CLI with XQuery and XSLT against its 5,000,000 / 1,100,000 budget, sxml.wasm against 2,000,000 / 700,000, and compileQuery() and XSLT still not in the JavaScript package. Confirm the budgets, or ask for optional modules.
XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default (Proposed, ): no (write the declaration, as QT4 expects) or keep yes.
Phase 7 plan (): docs/tasks/phase-7.md is due after this gate, one packet per delayed feature.
CI (): still local only; macOS, Windows and MSVC have not been built since the Phase 0 gate (the CLI's new working-directory read is _getcwd there, untested).
